dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the wide mid-body section towards a pointed posterior termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: None; lateral margins exhibit a smooth, continuous curvature with no visible bulges or structural indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey/off-white median pixel intensity across the majority of the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey patches concentrated primarily in the posterior third of the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; high-gradient blending between the light-grey baseline and the slightly darker posterior mottling.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Several thin, linear, light-colored marks oriented longitudinally along the central dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible longitudinal linear scratches (likely rake marks) along the central and lower dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, dark circular aperture (blowhole) located at the anterior-most visible section of the head.
